steps.action: Stack the 1x2 bricks on top of the blue side walls, building up the back and front walls one layer higher around the red cylinder and gray slope.
watch_for: Stagger the bricks over the seams of the layer below so the wall stays strong
Leave the gap at the left front open as shown

steps.action: Place the two 1x1 side-stud bricks on the left ends of the back and front walls, with the side studs facing outward to the left.
watch_for: Side studs must point out to the left, not inward or forward
Place them at the left ends of the walls, not the right
